m03_decision.evidence: FirstRunBootstrapClaim and ProvisioningMembershipBinding expose a nominal external boundary and single-use bootstrap checks, but no cryptographic issuer authenticity, explicit environment/trust domain, retained authenticated history, or AccountGenesis operation/request authority.
m03_decision.required_prerequisite: A production deployment must create an authenticated, non-transferable BootstrapEntitlement in the independent issuer registry before first account issuance.
m03_decision.claimant_gap: M0.3 has account_id, future account-scoped device/operator identities and opaque provisioning context, but no authenticated pre-account provisioning principal identity or claimant key anchor.
